art_direction: 银蓝底灰珊瑚双眼，曲线连续，目光轻移向右。
composition_variation: Place the left bowl three percent lower and roughly one-fifth shallower, while the right is a little wider. Both upper lids follow smooth continuous curves with fine tapered ends. The large black pupils remain attached to their lids and shift gently right. Matching dusty coral bands appear beneath and beside them, with a single elongated ivory glint inside each pupil. The quiet pastel background must be visibly colored rather than almost white, matching the exact palette below; retain a soft, low-saturation paper color across the entire square. No background gradients or decorations.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Three user-supplied chat images were inspected locally for asymmetric crescent eyes, pale half-lidded bowl eyes and diagonally arranged brush eyes. Prompt text alone was transmitted; no attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. The earlier eyes-only constraint is retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet; matching iris colors, the specified reference-family eye shape and subtle matte texture; exactly two eyes, no eyebrow/mouth/head, no square cuts, jelly rendering or watermark
